newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota new Mark II exceeds sales target.
newsitem.headline: Toyota new Mark II exceeds sales target.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp said on Wednesday it received a total of 56,000 domestic orders for a new model of the mainstay Mark II luxury sedan and its sister models, the Chaser and Cresta, in the first month after their launch.
On September 5, Toyota launched the new models with monthly sales targets of 12,500 for the Mark II, 5,000 for the Chaser and 6,000 for the Cresta.
In late September, Toyota said its subsidiary Toyota Motor Kyushu Inc would operate for two extra days in October to boost output of Mark II and Chaser models.
The Kyushu unit is also likely to operate for some extra days in November, the spokesman said.
